verdict.rationale: Airwallex ships AgentOS, a toolkit letting AI agents read balances, create beneficiaries, issue cards, and build cashflow reports on production accounts, plus developer connectors linking AI coding agents (Cursor, Claude Code, Codex) to docs and sandbox, and a documented MCP-style server for agent access — enabling natural-language-driven operation via an agent layer rather than a native NL interface for end users. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of the NL command experience, detail on the range of supported commands, and confirmation this works for non-technical end users rather than developer-configured agents.
